brief: You are an elite creative director. Design the bottle + packaging for "Conceptial", a new luxury fragrance. Give EIGHT radically different, ownable, manufacturable creative design directions — each a distinct world (form, material/finish, palette, the world it lives in). Make them as different from each other as possible. Avoid cliches: clear rectangular glass, gold cap, serif-on-white, crystal stopper, atomizer+tassel, minimalist flacon. Respond as JSON {"directions":[{"name","form","material_finish","palette","world","image_prompt"}, ... x8]}.

territories.name: Neo-Gothic Reverie

territories.material_finish: blackened steel with a matte patina and polished silver inlays
territories.world: an ethereal realm where the dark elegance of gothic cathedrals meets avant-garde fashion
territories.image_prompt: a mysterious, twisted spire bottle made of dark steel with silver inlays, set against a backdrop of gothic arches in an ethereal mist
